      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunSplitToRun</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunSplitToDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RunAtNightRun" name="Run at the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunSplitToRun</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunToRunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunSplitToDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkToRunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunJoin" name="Running and drinking finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunToRunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkToRunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunJoinToRecordTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordFinalTime" name="Record final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunJoinToRecordTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecordToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RunCompleted" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecordToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSelectBlock" sourceRef="StartEvent_Participate" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectBlockToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToRun5km" sourceRef="Gateway_RetryMerge" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run5kmToMeasure" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Task_MeasureTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeasureToTimeCheck" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under25" name="Less than 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${measuredTimeMinutes < 25}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder25" name="Not less than 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_TrainAndCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainToMerge" sourceRef="Task_TrainAndCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NumberToDetermineTime" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_DetermineTimeLeft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineToTransportSplit" sourceRef="Task_DetermineTimeLeft" targetRef="Gateway_TransportSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHome" name="More than one hour left" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportSplit" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${minutesLeftBetweenStartAndWorkEnd > 60}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportSplit" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHomeToMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWorkToMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToRunSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RunSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunSplitToRun" sourceRef="Gateway_RunSplit" targetRef="Task_RunAtNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunSplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_RunSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunToRunJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunAtNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToRunJoin" sourceRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" targetRef="Gateway_RunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunJoinToRecordTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RunJoin" targetRef="Task_RecordFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RecordFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_RunCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ViennaNightRun" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Participation">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Runner" name="Runner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Participate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RetryMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Run5km</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TrainAndCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineTimeLeft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TransportSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TransportMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunAtNightRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DrinkWhileRunning</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RunCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FitnessGadget" name="Fitness Gadget">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeasureTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Participate" name="Want to participate">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectBlockToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetryMerge" name="Retry merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectBlockToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToRun5km</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Run5km" name="Run 5 km">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToRun5km</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run5kmToMeasure</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_MeasureTime" name="Measure 5 km time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run5kmToMeasure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MeasureToTimeCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeCheck" name="Under 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotUnder25">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MeasureToTimeCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Under25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_TrainAndCheck" name="Train and check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Under25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NumberToDetermineTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DetermineTimeLeft" name="Determine time left between starting time and workday end">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NumberToDetermineTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DetermineToTransportSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TransportSplit" name="More than one hour left?" default="Flow_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DetermineToTransportSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go there from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoFromHomeToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWorkToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TransportMerge" name="Transport decided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoFromHomeToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWorkToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToRunSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunSplit" name="Run and drink">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToRunSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunSplitToRun</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunSplitToDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RunAtNightRun" name="Run at the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunSplitToRun</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunToRunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunSplitToDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkToRunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunJoin" name="Running and drinking finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunToRunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkToRunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunJoinToRecordTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordFinalTime" name="Record final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunJoinToRecordTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecordToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RunCompleted" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecordToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSelectBlock" sourceRef="StartEvent_Participate" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectBlockToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToRun5km" sourceRef="Gateway_RetryMerge" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run5kmToMeasure" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Task_MeasureTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeasureToTimeCheck" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under25" name="Less than 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${measuredTimeMinutes < 25}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder25" name="Not less than 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_TrainAndCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainToMerge" sourceRef="Task_TrainAndCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NumberToDetermineTime" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_DetermineTimeLeft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineToTransportSplit" sourceRef="Task_DetermineTimeLeft" targetRef="Gateway_TransportSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHome" name="More than one hour left" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportSplit" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${minutesLeftBetweenStartAndWorkEnd > 60}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportSplit" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHomeToMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWorkToMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_TransportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToRunSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RunSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunSplitToRun" sourceRef="Gateway_RunSplit" targetRef="Task_RunAtNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunSplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_RunSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunToRunJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunAtNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToRunJoin" sourceRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" targetRef="Gateway_RunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunJoinToRecordTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RunJoin" targetRef="Task_RecordFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RecordFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_RunCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states a decision whose condition depends on a value that an earlier step must obtain, such as a measured result or a computed difference between stated moments, and the description names that step as an action to perform or a value to find out: Model the action that obtains the value (a task of the type that matches the work: manual, service or user task) as its own task placed before the exclusive gateway that tests the value. Connect it by a sequence flow so that the decision reads the result of that task. Do not omit the obtaining action, and do not fold it into the decision or into an earlier task.
rules.situation: the description states a decision whose condition depends on a value that an earlier step must obtain, such as a measured result or a computed difference between stated moments, and the description names that step as an action to perform or a value to find out

rules.instruction: When the description states that one party performs two activities joined by 'and', with no stated order between them, and both must be finished before the next described step: Model the two activities as parallel branches: place a parallel gateway split before them, connect each activity to a parallel gateway join, and continue from the join to the next step. Do not sequence the activities one after the other unless the description orders them, and do not put an exclusive gateway between them.
rules.situation: the description states that one actor carries out two activities while the other is ongoing, joined by 'while', 'also', or a similar phrase, with no order stated between them

rules.instruction: When the description says that an actor performs one activity while also performing another activity concurrently, and the next step depends on both activities being completed: Model each of the concurrent activities as its own task on a separate branch after a parallel gateway split, with one unconditional outgoing flow per branch. Do not sequence these activities, and do not merge them into one task or route them through an exclusive gateway. Rejoin the branches with a parallel gateway before the next step, so that it starts only after all branches have ended. Keep any activity the description states as sequential before or after this block in its stated order, outside the parallel branches.
rules.situation: the description says that an actor performs one activity while also performing another activity concurrently, and the next step depends on both activities being completed
